proof_scope: Bounded typed variable expansion and the fail-closed watch policy (#1438), over the LIVE VS Code bridge: a nested dict expands to the requested depth capturing only requested locals (debugpy pseudo-children skipped), a self-referential list terminates with a cycle marker, oversized values truncate with original-size metadata, secret-shaped locals are redacted while prose-shaped big strings are NOT (hex false-positive guard), a call-shaped watch is blocked by default with a named side-effect reason while a safe comparison evaluates, an explicitly allowed risky watch is evaluated AND audited in the persisted state, and a missing expansion target invalidates only that inspection. Watch classification/redaction/truncation/limit-clamping are additionally covered deterministically by vscode-bridge/scripts/protocol-tests.mjs.

claims.proves: the live bridge captures structured bounded expansions (children, cycle markers, limits), enforces allowWatchEval->classification->allowRiskyWatches fail-closed ordering with an audit trail, redacts secret-shaped values without over-redacting prose, and degrades a missing target to a named per-inspection error
claims.does_not_prove: behavior for TypeScript/Rust adapters (Python debugpy only here), or bounded evaluation latency enforcement where the adapter does not support it

cases.name: live-bounded-expansion-cycle-redaction-and-block
cases.description: One live stop: expand a nested dict (depth 3) and a self-referential list; capture an oversized string and a secret-named local; one safe and one call-shaped watch. Asserts children, cycle, truncate-not-redact, redact, evaluate, block.
command:
set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action restart --launch-config-name 'Debug nested ($debugger)' --break "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/nested.py:12" --local payload --local blob --local api_token --expand payload:3 --expand loop:3 --expand missing_var --watch 'payload["count"] > 2' --watch 'build()' --allow-watch-eval --stop-timeout-ms 45000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 75); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; [ "$S" = stopped ] || [ "$S" = stopped-not-proof ] || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; python3 - "$OUT" <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); ss = d.get("stoppedState") or {}
loc = ss.get("locals") or {}; exp = ss.get("expanded") or {}; w = ss.get("watches") or {}
assert "<redacted" in loc.get("api_token",""), loc.get("api_token")
assert "<redacted" not in loc.get("blob",""), "blob over-redacted"
print("REDACTION-CORRECT")
p = exp.get("payload", {}); kids = list((p.get("children") or {}).keys())
assert any("user" in k for k in kids) and any("count" in k for k in kids), kids
assert not any("special variables" in k for k in kids), kids
print("EXPANSION-CHILDREN-CORRECT")
def cyc(n):
    if n.get("cycle"): return True
    return any(cyc(c) for c in (n.get("children") or {}).values())
assert cyc(exp.get("loop", {})), "no cycle marker"
print("CYCLE-MARKED")
assert (exp.get("missing_var") or {}).get("error"), "missing target must carry its own error"
print("MISSING-TARGET-ISOLATED")
assert w.get('payload["count"] > 2') == "True", w
assert "<blocked: side-effect risk" in w.get("build()",""), w
print("WATCH-POLICY-CORRECT")
PYEOF

cases.name: live-risky-watch-requires-explicit-audit
cases.description: Watches without --allow-watch-eval are refused up front at request validation (strictest fail-closed); with eval but not --allow-risky-watches a call is blocked per-watch with a named reason; with --allow-risky-watches it evaluates AND lands in auditedRiskyWatches.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; run(){ OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action restart --launch-config-name 'Debug nested ($debugger)' --break "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/nested.py:12" --local payload --watch 'len(payload)' "$@" --stop-timeout-ms 45000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 75); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$OUT'));ss=d.get('stoppedState') or {};print(json.dumps({'w':ss.get('watches'),'a':ss.get('auditedRiskyWatches'),'e':d.get('error')}))"; }; R1=$(run); echo "no-eval: $R1"; echo "$R1" | grep -q 'requires allowWatchEval' || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; echo NO-EVAL-REFUSED-UPFRONT; R2=$(run --allow-watch-eval); echo "no-risky: $R2"; echo "$R2" | grep -q 'side-effect risk' && echo RISKY-BLOCKED || exit 1; R3=$(run --allow-watch-eval --allow-risky-watches); echo "audited: $R3"; echo "$R3" | grep -q '"a": \[' && echo "$R3" | grep -vq 'side-effect risk' && echo RISKY-AUDITED-AND-EVALUATED || exit 1

cases.name: classification-and-redaction-unit-gate
cases.description: The deterministic protocol test suite (classification of calls/assignments/dunders/statements as risky, safe chains as safe, redaction name+value patterns, truncation metadata, limit clamping) must pass; a regression here fails the gate.
